title: Percentage of Grassroots Advisors Who are Members of Political Party
what_it_is: Percentage of Grassroots Advisors Who are Members of Political Party

sections.label: PA role and grassroots advisors
sections.summary: The PA promotes social cohesion, bridges Government and people, and appoints grassroots advisors to guide grassroots organisations in implementing government policies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Its role is to promote social cohesion and to act as a bridge between the Government and the people.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The PA appoints grassroots advisors (GRAs) to guide its grassroots organisations (GROs) in communicating and implementing the policies and programmes of the government of the day.

sections.label: Party membership and GRA appointment
sections.summary: Membership of a political party is neither a qualification nor a disqualification for appointment as a grassroots advisor.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Membership of a political party is neither a qualification nor a disqualification for the purpose of being appointed a GRA.

sections.label: Applying for assistance
sections.summary: Anyone who needs help and meets the eligibility criteria may apply for assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Anyone who needs help and meets the eligibility criteria may apply for assistance.

sections.label: Equal help for eligible residents
sections.summary: Eligible residents are helped equally regardless of where they live, and can be referred by MPs, VWOs or grassroots advisors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: No matter where you live in Singapore, if the resident is eligible for help according to the national guidelines, everyone is helped equally.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: It can be referred to by their respective Members of Parliament; it can be referred to by the VWOs; it can be referred to by the GRAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: All of us can play a part to refer needy residents to the agencies for help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And I do not think there is any discrimination based on that.
